headline: Verist Law advises KrazyBee on ₹500 crore NCD issuance
sum: KrazyBee Services Limited has made a ₹500 crore issuance of 50,000 senior secured listed fully paid-up non-convertible debentures including a green shoe option of up to ₹250 crore. Verist Law advised KrazyBee Services on this NCD issuance.
detail: KrazyBee Services Limited has made a ₹500 crore issuance of 50,000 senior secured listed fully paid-up non-convertible debentures including a green shoe option of up to ₹250 crore. Verist Law advised KrazyBee Services on this NCD issuance. The transaction team consisted of Sudha Muddaiah (Partner), Megan Carvalho (Senior Associate) and Sruti Patra (Associate). KrazyBee Services is an RBI-registered NBFC associated with KreditBee, a unicorn digital lending platform in India.

sources.name: Bar & Bench - Dealstreet
